requirements.requirement: Run a long-running background worker on node1 as a managed service named inventory-worker.
requirements.summary: inventory-worker.service was enabled and active, its log grew during observation, and it returned active with continuing writes after the node restart.

requirements.requirement: Confine the worker so it can write only inside /var/lib/inventory.
requirements.summary: The installed unit makes /var/lib/inventory its explicit writable state path while applying strict filesystem protection and inaccessible temporary paths. Runtime namespace probes allowed a write inside that directory and denied writes to /etc and /tmp; confinement was rechecked after restart.

requirements.requirement: Ensure the worker gains no new privileges.
requirements.summary: The unit has NoNewPrivileges enabled, and the running process directly reported NoNewPrivs=1 both before and after restart.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The mandatory node-restart protocol was also complete: it captured a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged the restart, observed a changed boot identity, and demonstrated recovered service, preserved data, continuing writes, and retained confinement. The lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: Runtime write-denial probes sampled /etc and /tmp before restart and /etc after restart rather than attempting every possible outside path; the broader conclusion is supported by the installed ProtectSystem=strict, ReadWritePaths, ProtectHome, and InaccessiblePaths configuration.
The lifecycle snapshots do not inventory the custom unit or its data directly, so final service and data state rely on the executor's direct commands.

operational_hygiene.summary: One unnecessary, bounded mutation occurred: the failed encoded-blob installation attempt created or truncated the worker and unit files before failing because xxd was unavailable. Those files were fully overwritten by the successful installation moments later, so no residue remained. All other mutations had clear roles in installation, confinement, verification, or the mandatory restart protocol. Final observations showed no failed services, damaged package state, or new network exposure.
